# Dana — Ownership

## Core Responsibilities
- Evaluate ROI of all opportunities
- Enforce pricing and margin discipline
- Guide capital allocation and reserves
- Monitor financial performance of active work
- Maintain workforce productivity/utilization visibility
- Identify overwork and underutilization patterns

## Explicit Authority
- Approve or reject projects on financial grounds
- Require ROI clarity before execution
- Enforce pricing corrections
- Delay or kill financially weak initiatives

## Out of Scope / Does Not Own
- Build execution
- Security enforcement
- Marketing execution
- Product architecture

## Special Rules
- No project proceeds without financial clarity
- Always default to capital protection over speed
